comment: Why: the Celestial Court is open to the sky (glass roofs, terraces, fountains) and bright by day and night, so a party that carries a light is the normal case and the dice would find it often; the roll bonus of minus two cancels most of that, the same as the tower of light. The monsters are the court itself: ushers and heralds (the construct tag and vexes), the archons' gilded armour (living armour), the judges (evoker and illusioner, two different tricks), the sentinels of the gates (iron golems) and, for the party that douses its light, the condemned: the dead who came to this court and were judged. The court never ambushes from the dark; it tries you, and the harder bands are the sentence.
description: The Holy road's heavenly court: terraces, golden gates and a throne room. Ushers, archons in gilded armour, judges, gate sentinels and a verdict.

entries.comment: The breather of the court: one or two of the room's own people (the construct tag unless the room has a native faction), who ask your business before they ask anything else. No upper threat, so the minor band never runs dry.
Motes of the court's own light made flesh: a couple of vexes drawn to a bright party, the common nuisance of a place where every party is bright.
The court keeps owls in its aviaries, and the doors of an aviary are not always shut: two or three drawn to a lit party, cheap and fast, from the terraces.
The evergreen standard encounter: the archons' gilded armour on its rounds. The id is explicit so the first floors, where the construct tag is thin, still have a reliable fight.
Spirits and winds of the elemental tag that sing the court's hours, drawn to a lit party. The tag decides who comes (breezes, Tensura's spirits and the rest within the toughness window).
The golden gate is not shut by a bar: an iron sentinel stands in it with a gilded guard at its side. A short range and a short hunt, because a sentinel keeps its post.

Two judges and their conjured witnesses: an evoker and an illusioner (two different tricks, blindness against fangs) with a few vexes. Casters first; the witnesses are trimmed first when the budget is short.

The rare dark entry of this road: a party that puts its lights out has not been judged yet, and the court's own dead (the undead tag, the ones who were) come to see to it. One or two, never scaled by the party.
The loud brute: the court's executioner, an iron golem, wakes to a noisy party; a sentence is carried out where it was passed. One body, a lot of health; hard band only and from threat 3.

The full bench for a party that shines: an evoker and an illusioner with a few vexes for witnesses and the court's constructs as bailiffs. Casters first; the bailiffs come last in the order of trimming.
The mimic-style surprise: the statues between the columns step down, gilded armour with a judge's caster at its shoulder. Close range and a short hunt.
The wave of the court: a horn from the terrace and the host comes, many conjured lights in three places and a judge behind them.
The late ambush: sentinels and the armour of the archons in procession, from two sides. Only for parties of two or more.
